description: İSKİ: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İSKİ. Coverage: İSKİ. The listing groups 15 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: İstanbul Barajları Konum Bilgileri; İstanbul Bölgelere Verilen Temiz Su Miktarları; İSKİ Duyuruları; Number of Incoming and Answered Water Faults of ISKI Based on District. Formats seen: XLSX, KML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
